name: collapsible
title: Collapsible
blurb: Single section that expands and collapses under a trigger.
description: Radix UI Collapsible primitive. Click trigger to toggle content visibility. No multi-section state management.
use_when: Single progressive disclosure section, advanced options, or side details.
avoid_when: Multiple independent collapsible sections — use Accordion instead.
a11y: Trigger button with aria-expanded. Radix-managed focus and keyboard navigation.
